---
title: Focus ring light/dark pair
format:
  html:
    theme:
      light: cosmo
      dark: darkly
---

Fixture for the page-aware focus ring on a paired `light:`/`dark:` theme.
Quarto compiles the two themes into separate stylesheets, and each one
resolves the focus ring against its own `$body-bg`. The light (cosmo)
stylesheet keeps the dark tone on the outline; the dark (darkly) stylesheet
swaps the tones so the outline is white. Switching the color scheme at
runtime switches which stylesheet is active, and the ring must switch with
it.

An [inline link](#target) in the body.
